name: How much does a second story addition typically cost in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: How much does a second story addition typically cost in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a second story addition in Orange County varies significantly based on factors such as the size of the addition, complexity of the design, types of materials used, and interior finishes. It can range from $150,000 to $500,000 or more. This estimate typically covers design, permits, structural work, and standard finishes. Luxury materials or extensive site work will increase the overall investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Second story addition costs in Orange County range from $150,000 to over $500,000, depending on size, design complexity, and material choices.
